newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dlr, firms on pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee weakens vs dlr, firms on pound.

text.p: The Mauritius rupee weakened against the dollar and firmed versus the pound on Friday, reflecting international market trends, foreign exchange dealers said.
The rupee traded at a commercial mean rate of 21.48 to the dollar from 21.4485 on Thursday and at 35.9215 to the pound from 35.951 on Thursday.
Forex dealers said the central bank sold dollars in the interbank market on Thursday afternoon below the prevailing interbank rate to prevent the rupee from trading weaker.
